text:
maria: Heads-up: planning to publish the customer release post Fri 09:00am PT. Need final changelog link, live docs URL, canary window, short benchmark line for the announcement, and confirmation of partner embargo window. @simon @nina @raja

simon: Changelog is in review: https://redwood.in/changelog/v1.5.0-draft — I'll merge by Thu noon PT if no last comments. Canary plan: Thu 6pm PT start, 12% traffic for 90m, health check for 30m, then 50% for 2h before full roll.

nina: Docs will be published Thu 8:45pm PT at https://docs.redwood.in/release/v1.5.0 — will add a short "Quick highlights" paragraph. Need the 1-line headline and the 2-sentence social summary from marketing.

raja: Benchmark snippet for the blog: "Average per-token latency reduced by ~15% on 16k-context runs; sustained throughput increased ~1.8x at 95th percentile under mixed request sizes." Keep social simpler: "Faster long-context inference and more stable performance under load."

maria: Nice. For inbound leads/routing: sales wants the tracking slug added to the blog CTA so that dev trial signups route to the new Dedicated-interest queue. Can eng add UTM params to the docs and changelog links?

simon: Yes — will append ?utm_source=blog&utm_campaign=v1_5_0 to the final links before we publish. Also no legal hold. Partner embargo: recommend Thu 8:45am PT (15m before public) for partners.

raja: Ops note: We'll gate the new quant profiles with ff_feature_quant_v1_5. Canary command for the runbook: ```bash
# start canary rollout
redwoodctl rollout start --release=v1.5.0 --canary=12 --stages="12,50,100" --monitor=30m
# feature flag toggle if we need to test quant separately
redwoodctl feature toggle ff_feature_quant_v1_5 --on --env=canary
```

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: Thu 2024-04-18T18:00:00-07:00. Notifying #eng-oncall and #release-health.

nina: Docs link posted (live): https://docs.redwood.in/release/v1.5.0 — added Quick highlights: "Smoothed latency for long-context models and smarter batching heuristics; safer rollouts with feature-flagged quantization."

maria: Marketing will finalize blog copy by Thu 6pm PT and schedule the post for Fri 09:00am PT. Social cadence ready: initial post + follow-up thread with benchmark explainer. Can someone from eng confirm we can share the technical benchmark slide at the webinar Fri 10:30am PT?

simon: Confirmed. Raja will present one slide on test harness and metrics.

raja: I'll prepare the slide and drop it here by Thu 5pm PT. Also will publish the canary health checks to #release-health when it starts.

maria: Action list: Simon — merge changelog and add UTM; Nina — confirm docs header and CTA links (done); Raja — slide + canary health updates; Marketing — finalize copy and post schedule. I'll post a preflight checklist Thu 7pm PT. :rocket:

simon: Roger. I'll ping here once changelog is merged and the final links are ready.

deploy-bot: Canary started. Monitoring channels: #release-health, #eng-oncall.

maria: Thank you all — will share final publish manifest once everything is green.
